neighbours.label: Katakana 'the' (ザ) right after a spaced katakana 'in' or 'on' (イン ザ / オン ザ), i.e. English 'in the' / 'on the' written word by word in katakana inside a title or name mid-sentence; weaker after ウィズ (with); quiet after other prepositions (アンダー, アット, バイ, オブ, フロム), when glued (インザ) or dotted (・ザ・), and at the very start of the text.
